id.description: One word; must equal the file name without .json

order.description: Where the event stands in the list; the yearly draw depends on it

role.description: Who in the clan it involves

trigger.description: A condition in the rule language; empty means always possible

requires.description: An affinity the hero must have reached

affinity.description: hunter, gatherer, knapper, fireKeeper, shaman, trade, religion with a whole number

opinion.description: What the other person thinks of the hero afterwards

trait.description: A trait the hero gains (brave, kind...)
